name: Fence installation
summary: Fences priced from infill feet, line and terminal posts, walk and drive gates, and tear-out.

items.label: Wood privacy fence infill, 6 ft, heavy clay
items.source: 0.14 h/lf x 1.3 heavy-clay multiplier (MATERIAL_PRESETS wood-privacy-6, DIG_PRESETS clay selected in index.html); $14/lf; 140 ft run less 4 ft walk + 12 ft drive gate (index.html default run, WALK/DRIVE_GATE_WIDTH_FT)

items.label: Line posts set in concrete
items.source: 0.5 h/post x 1.3; line post $22 + concrete $10 (wood-privacy-6); countPosts: ceil(140/8)+1+2 corners = 21 posts, 8 of them terminal or gate

items.label: Corner, end and gate posts set in concrete
items.source: 0.5 h/post x 1.3; terminal post $36 + concrete $10 (wood-privacy-6); 2 ends + 2 corners + 4 gate posts (countPosts, applyGatePosts)

items.label: Tear out and haul old fence
items.source: 0.18 h/ft x 1.3; haul/dump $4/ft; 40 ft default (index.html tearOutFeet, hoursPerTearOutLf, tearOutPerFoot)
